Stream — chat, feeds and video

getstream/chat · version 1

envs add getstream/chat

This declares the keys below in your catalog and sets none of them. A template is a schema for keys; it never carries a value.

Key Needed Kind Notes
STREAM_API_KEY required config The exception among realtime providers: Stream's own client snippet passes the raw key to the browser when initialising the chat client, so a working install publishes it. One pair serves every Stream product in an application.. where to get it
STREAM_API_SECRET required secret Stream says user tokens can only be safely generated from a server. Compromised tokens are revoked by a cutoff time rather than by rotating this, and that cutoff can be lifted again.. where to get it
